start: Menu, 'Shop', a new order placed by a member in the app

steps.action: Open Shop
user_sees: Title 'Shop', 'What members order in the MettleUp app, and what you sell', tabs 'Orders' / 'Products'

Chips 'New', 'Ready', 'Collected', 'Cancelled', 'All' with counts; under 'New' a card 'Order <no>', the member's name, '<time ago> · <clock time>', each item with its amount, 'Total' and the mark 'New'
Buttons 'Mark ready', 'Collected (paid)' and 'Cancel order'
must_not: Orders of another gym
A total that is not the sum of the lines
'Loading orders…' that never ends

steps.action: Tap 'Mark ready'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…'; note 'Order <no> is ready. <member> can see this in the app.'; the card moves to 'Ready' and the counts change
must_not: The order in both New and Ready
The member not told the order is ready
Stock taken a second time

steps.action: Under 'Ready', when the member pays at the desk, tap 'Collected (paid)'
user_sees: Note 'Order <no> collected. <amount> taken.'; the card moves to 'Collected' and has no buttons
must_not: An online payment link for this order still open after the desk took the money
The amount in the note different from the order total

start: Today page with a new order (other ways in)

steps.action: Tap the line '<n> new shop orders to get ready', or the Shop card's button, or the quick action 'Shop orders', or the Shop entry with its number in the menu
user_sees: The Shop page on the orders list with 'New' chosen
must_not: A number on Today or in the menu that differs from the 'New' count
The Products tab opened instead

steps.action: Wait with the list open while a member orders
user_sees: The new card appears by itself on the next refresh (every 60 seconds)
must_not: The order never showing until a reload

start: Orders list, a new order the member collects at once (another kind: skip 'ready')

steps.action: On a 'New' order tap 'Collected (paid)'
user_sees: Note 'Order <no> collected. <amount> taken.'; the card moves straight to 'Collected'
must_not: A question that needs 'Mark ready' first
The order left under 'New'

start: Orders list, things that must be refused

steps.action: Tap 'Collected (paid)' on an order the member paid online a moment ago
user_sees: A red line on the card saying the member has just paid online, so no money is to be taken; the order stays open
must_not: The desk told to take money that was already paid online
The order marked collected twice

steps.action: Tap 'Mark ready' on an order another person changed or the member cancelled a moment ago
user_sees: A red line 'Someone already changed that order. We updated the list.' and the fresh list
must_not: A cancelled order turned back into ready
The old state painted over the new one

steps.action: Open Shop in a gym that has not turned on the member app
user_sees: Owner: the card with 'Turn on the shop'. Staff: 'The member app and shop are not turned on yet. Only an owner can turn them on.'
must_not: An empty orders list that reads as 'no orders'

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap 'Mark ready'
user_sees: A red line 'Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again.'; the order stays as it was
must_not: A 'ready' note for a change that was not saved

steps.action: Tap 'Back to new'
user_sees: Note 'Order <no> is back to new.'; the card is under 'New' again with 'Mark ready', 'Collected (paid)', 'Cancel order'
must_not: The member still shown 'Ready' in the app

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel order'
user_sees: Sheet 'Cancel order <no>?': '<member>’s order for <amount> will be cancelled. The items go back into stock, and <member> sees “Cancelled” in the app. This cannot be undone.' with 'Keep it' and 'Cancel order'
must_not: The order cancelled by the first tap

steps.action: Tap 'Keep it', open the sheet again, tap 'Cancel order'
user_sees: Nothing changes on 'Keep it'; then 'Cancelling…', note 'Order <no> cancelled. Stock is back.'; the card is under 'Cancelled' with no buttons
must_not: Stock not given back, or given back twice
A cancelled or collected order that can be changed again
A paid online link left open for a cancelled order

steps.action: Look at an order the member cancelled in the app
user_sees: The mark 'Cancelled by member'
must_not: It shown as cancelled by the gym

start: Orders list, signed in as owner

steps.action: Read what a card shows
user_sees: The member's name, what they ordered, the amounts and the total of that one order
must_not: The member's mobile number, health data or other orders' totals added up
Orders of another gym

steps.action: Think of what the member sees
user_sees: The member sees 'Ready' and 'Cancelled' for their own order in the app
must_not: One member seeing another member's order
A day's or month's shop total shown to staff
